		Assistive OCR — Benchmark Results
	

Real, reproducible benchmark results for the assistive OCR wearable module (offline, multilingual — English, Bengali+English, Hindi+English). This repository is self-contained: it holds the results, the ground-truth manifest, and the 98 real images they were computed from, so it can be run and demoed directly with no other dataset needed.
